biggest_catch: You must park $20,000 of new, external money for 90 straight days — and the account must still be open when the bonus is credited afterward.
catches: Deposit at least $20,000 by 5:00 p.m. ET on 10/16/26 and maintain a balance of at least $20,000 for 90 consecutive days — dropping below $20,000 at any point disqualifies you.

The $20,000 must be new money from an external financial institution — internal Live Oak Bank transfers do not qualify (consistently documented by independent bank-bonus sites; the official page cites its bonus disclosure footnote for full terms).
The account must still be open when the bonus is credited after the 90-day period.
No monthly maintenance fees and no minimum balance to open the savings account otherwise; deposits are FDIC-insured.
The personal savings account has no checks or debit card; the 90-day window runs from when the new money reaches the balance threshold.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to participate; no monthly maintenance fees and no minimum balance to open.

c4.evidence: Official page cites its bonus disclosure footnote for payout details; independent bank-bonus sites consistently report the bonus is deposited within 45 days after the 90-day period.
